style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, cute satire, comic horror
anatomy: the alpaca has EXACTLY four legs — two front, two back — one neck, one head, one tail. Under the coat of tags they stay four: a leg hidden behind a tag is hidden, never replaced by a new one
motion_rule: 12 separate movements in 10 seconds, one per beat below, each big enough to read on a phone. Nothing comes to rest: every tag slams on and springs off, the coat builds out of that churn
camera_moves: the camera never rests — every beat below carries its own move and its own shot size
character: a fluffy white alpaca, long neck, absurd fringe, buck teeth, huge eyes, stand-up comic energy
cast: the GOAT: grey-brown, big horns, square yellow pupils, a fan of paper coupons and a pan flute
props: TAGS: price tags with butterfly wings, each a different bright colour — scarlet, lime, turquoise, gold — with a big embossed currency sign, no words
environment: sunlit Swiss alpine meadow, flowers, snowy peaks behind
lighting: blazing alpine noon, hard sun, crisp shadows; the horror is in the teeth

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: bright confident female voice, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: 0.8-3.35 is ONE unbroken phrase, no break at 1.95 or 2.65; 5.0-7.0 is ONE unbroken phrase, the words run across the 5.9 boundary; voiceless after 7.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: a light fairground pan flute all clip, wind in the grass, a sharp CLICK at 8.6, then the flute alone

timeline.a: silent. HOOK: the camera charges low through the grass into her buck-toothed face until the teeth almost touch the lens
she rocks her whole body at the lens while the camera tilts up her neck and the GOAT gallops in from the right, huge and close
no break. The camera whips right after the goat and his coupon fan wipes the frame
no break. She throws her head up and the camera swings back left, her flank wiping the lens
silent. The meadow erupts: a swarm of BRIGHT tags lifts off the flowers while the camera drops to grass level under them
silent. The camera cranes straight up through the swarm, wings beating past the lens and blanking it twice
one scarlet tag lands flat on the lens, covers the whole frame, then flutters off her nose as the camera pushes in on her eyes
no break, the phrase runs on. The camera orbits her a full turn, meadow and peaks wheeling behind, while the swarm rams her from three sides
silent. She spins on the spot inside the coat, tags streaming off her flanks, and the camera pulls back to her whole four-legged silhouette
silent. Every tag turns at once: wings still beating, the bodies swell into goggle-eyed PIRANHA heads with small sharp teeth, while the camera arcs low around her four hooves
silent. CLICK: every piranha bites at once, she jolts up on all fours and the camera hauls back as the coloured swarm bursts outward
silent. The camera drives into her eyes as they blow wide in comic horror, the grin frozen, piranhas raining past

must_appear: multicoloured butterfly tags, a coat of tags on her, every tag turning into a goggle-eyed piranha with teeth, her eyes wide in comic horror
negative_prompt: letters, cyrillic, readable text, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, people, hands, live insects, blood, a second alpaca, five legs, a fifth leg, an extra limb, duplicated legs, deformed anatomy, slow motion, static camera, the alpaca standing still, a motionless coat of tags, tags coming to rest on her, a talking head with an empty frame, accented Russian
